name: Draw Rescue
title: Draw Rescue: Ball Physics Game
short: Draw a line, save the ball and roll it into the cup of its own color. One finger, real physics, boss levels and new worlds to explore.
tagline: Draw a line. Save the ball. Roll it into the right cup.
intro: Colored balls fall from above and each one has to reach the cup of its own color before your ink runs out. One simple move, real physics and a fresh challenge in every level.
shotAlts: Draw a line, save the ball
Roll it into the right cup

sections.title: Four simple moves
items: Drag one finger to draw a line. Your ink is limited and the line fades after a moment.
Every ball rolls with real physics: slopes, bounces, spin and speed all matter.
Send each ball into the cup that matches its color.
Rescue balls back to back to build a combo and multiply your score.

sections.title: A drawing game that keeps changing
sections.text: Levels keep being added, so there is always one more to try.
items: Glass that has to break first, switch colors, ice shells, bombs and jokers.
Pegs, ramps, spinning gears, wind bands, funnels, crates, lasers and locked cups.
Slick, bouncy, sticky, painting and permanent lines change how every level plays.
Fill the cups, break the glass, hit a combo, finish flawless, paint the floor or find the treasure cup.

sections.title: From candy valleys to the clouds
sections.text: Every world brings new toys to play with, and bosses are waiting along the way.
items: Bumpers, balloons to pop, cups on rails, portals and festival levels full of surprise balls.
Launch balls with a slingshot, open gates with buttons and drop them into cups that sway like a Ferris wheel.
Upside-down gravity, slow moon gravity, big fans and birds that carry the balls away.
Black holes pull the balls in, while a magnet line pulls them toward your drawing.
Magnet, lightning, time and rainbow balls help you out, and two of them can merge into a super combo.
Face the Juggler and the Storm Bird and bring them down with your cups and special balls.

sections.title: Pick a booster before you play
sections.text: Choose a booster when a level starts and pay for it with diamonds.
items: Start the level with 5 extra balls.
One more mistake allowed in Flawless levels.
One of 3 cups is removed, the rest get wider.

sections.title: Your progress, on every phone
sections.text: Signing in is optional: you can play without it.
items: Unlock achievements as you rescue balls and clear levels.
Compare the balls you have rescued and your highest level with other players.
Pick up where you left off on a new phone, with your diamonds and boosters.

sections.title: Play it anywhere, any time
items: Perfect for a queue or a coffee break.
A video only plays when you tap a reward button yourself.
sections.note: Free to play, with optional in-app purchases (diamonds and unlimited lives). Game languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

cta: Ready to draw your first line?

name: FunCopter
title: FunCopter: Helicopter Game
short: Choose your helicopter, attack but don't crash! Collect gold, unlock new copters and fly past monsters and aliens.
tagline: Choose your helicopter, attack but don't crash, join the fun!
intro: A high-speed air combat game full of thrilling maneuvers. Take down enemies in the sky, dodge the obstacles that await you and fight your way to victory.

sections.title: Built for sky-high fun
items: Collect gold to unlock more fun flying helicopters.
Each helicopter has its own armed attack and a special ability, so try different copters on tough levels.
Special items give you protective shields, shrinking and gold enlargement.
Explore different planets full of monsters and aliens.
Your helicopters carry bombs to clear the obstacles ahead.
No internet connection needed to play.

name: Fun Math
title: Fun Math: Math Games
short: Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with game-style challenges that get harder as you level up.
intro: Math questions turn into games: answer correctly and your character attacks, answer wrong and the enemy strikes back. Levels get harder step by step, from the four operations up to more advanced questions.

sections.title: Three ways to practice
items: Your correct answers attack your character's enemy. Answer wrong and the enemy attacks you.
Get a target number for your level and reach it by combining numbers with the operations.
Listen to numbers spoken in English and pick the right one while you learn them.

sections.title: All four operations
items: Warm up with sums and differences, then speed up.
Move on to times tables and division questions.
As the levels progress, the questions become more difficult.
Replay a level as often as you like to get better at it.

name: Fun Run Maze Game
title: Fun Run Maze Game
short: Race through the maze, find the right way, collect gold and slow down your rivals with power-ups.
tagline: This is not just running: find the right way!
intro: Race against your rivals through a 3D maze. Use the map to find the right path, grab gold to unlock new characters and use your abilities to slow the others down.

sections.title: Think fast, run smart
items: Use the navigation to find the right way instead of just running.
Gold in the maze unlocks more characters to run with.
Pick up objects and throw them to slow your rivals down. Careful, they can do the same to you.

sections.title: Grab the question-mark boxes
items: Reveal the right way through the maze for a short time.
Throw lightning at all of your opponents at once.
Set a trap for the runners behind you.

name: Gold Warrior
title: Gold Warrior
short: Fight zombies and goblins, rescue the captured people and power up the golden warrior level by level.
tagline: Save your country from zombies and goblins.
intro: The golden warrior's country has been overrun by zombies and goblins, and its people have been taken prisoner. In each level he rescues some of the captives, defeats every enemy and faces tougher bosses along the way.

sections.title: A warrior on a rescue mission
items: Free some of the captured people in every level.
Face many bosses as the game goes on.
Break barrels and chests with your sword to refill them.
The level screen shows when each new feature unlocks.

sections.title: Grow stronger
items: Raise it to earn more from every gold coin you collect.
Raise it to take less damage from enemies.
Raise it to deal double damage to enemies.

name: Numbers Game
title: Numbers Game and Math Game
short: Kids learn English numbers by listening and practice simple sums in a race against time.
intro: A simple learning game for children: hear a number in English and find it, or solve easy sums before the time runs out. It helps kids improve their listening and understanding.

sections.title: Listen, count and win
items: Hear numbers spoken in English and pick the right one.
Easy addition questions made for young learners.
Race against time and try to win the game.
